description: Answer bounded approximate-distance queries using Wulff-Nilsen's even-level interval search over a supplied k=16 Thorup-Zwick hierarchy.

pinned_sources.repository: Encyclopedia of Algorithms EPUB supplied by the user
pinned_sources.chapter: Approximate Distance Oracles with Improved Query Time

pinned_sources.title: Approximate Distance Oracles with Improved Query Time

contract.operation: For fixed k=16, preprocess the source-specific even-index interval split tree from distance gaps, then answer each query by binary interval search and the ordinary alternating-bunch dist_k scan in the terminal short interval.
contract.hierarchy: A0=V; A1 through A15 are supplied nonempty nested masks; A16 is empty. The masks replay a hierarchy realization and no randomized expectation is measured.
contract.graph: Simple connected undirected graph for n>1, positive integer weights 1..1000, endpoints u<v, edges in strict lexicographic order.
contract.interval_split: For [i1,i2] with i2-i1>4, choose even i in [i1+2,i2-2] nearest the midpoint, lower i on ties. Choose even j in [i1,i-2] maximizing delta_j(source)=d(source,p_(j+2)(source))-d(source,p_j(source)); lower j on ties. Recurse on [i1,j] and [i,i2].
contract.query_rule: At each split evaluate both membership tests p_j(source) in B(target) and p_(j+1)(target) in B(source). If both are false, take [i,i2]; otherwise take [i1,j]. When i2-i1<=4, run Figure 2 dist_k from i1, alternating endpoints and increasing the level after each failed membership test.
contract.probe_count: Equal endpoints use a profile-level exact-distance fast path and emit (0,0) without entering the recurrence. Otherwise count each individual bunch-membership lookup: two at every internal interval split and one per dist_k loop iteration.
contract.error_precedence: Input validation precedes output-null and output-capacity checks.

workspace.meaning: 16,384-byte cap. The widest 64-bit int layout uses 13,568 bytes for State (512 distance + 1,024 nearest + 64 bunch + 11,904 interval nodes + 64 counts), plus 128 hierarchy-mask bytes and 520 staged-output bytes = 14,216 bytes before scalar locals. The build tree has at most four recursive frames and is built before staged output allocation.
